milestones.name: Connect to the data repository with the real GitHub provider (connect only)
milestones.basis: Owner-named EXT-DATA-002, EXT-DATA-003, UI-001 (J1-01, J1-02). Added: EXT-DATA-013 as the scope-manifest dependsOn of UI-001 (UI-001-O1 shows the four catalog cases after Connect); its own dependencies STORAGE-005/007 are outside the scope manifest. Text additions: EXT-DATA-004 (secure connection flow, credential), EXT-DATA-005 (permission checks; ConnectResult and SM-CONNECTION T-N02 cite it), EXT-DATA-006 (no mutation on connect), EXT-DATA-007 (connection states), EXT-DATA-012 (configurable, isolated, untrusted repository), EXT-DATA-001 (no bundled fallback), PF-003 (real GitHub mode explicit), PF-015 (authenticated reads, no anonymous mode; cited by T-N02). Implemented by WI-GEN-EXT-DATA, WI-GEN-UI, WI-GEN-PF (all after T17) and T25 (after T20 -> T19, and T15). The T19 -> T20 edge is artificial for a read-only connect/load and genuine for write; T18, T13 (replay) and T15 stay genuine. ODR-R10-29 A (APR-R10-OWNER-3): UI-001 (its O1 shows the catalog cases) and EXT-DATA-013 move to M2, so M1 is connect only.

milestones.name: List and open historical investigations read-only
milestones.basis: Read-only list and open of the catalog cases. INV-039/040/041 (list, open, primary navigation), INV-042 and UI-029 (+ dependsOn UI-020) for J2-08's section navigation, INV-008 for J1-06's display of the problem statement, UI-025 (open leads to Overview), UI-014 (O3: distinguish frozen demonstrations from writable copies), EXT-DATA-011 (reader contract, fail closed), PERSIST-005 and PERSIST-017 (SM-LOAD sources T-L01/T-L03 and T-L02/T-L05/T-L06), UI-010 (SM-LOAD T-L04). Only the applicable parts of J1-06 and J2-08 apply: INV-017/INV-037 are M4, INV-006 is M3, UI-003/UI-026 are M5. Forward dependencies not pulled: INV-008 -> INV-001 (M3; historical data already holds the problem statement), UI-010 -> PERSIST-020 (M4). Blocked regardless of ordering: no list operation and no workspace in the frozen contracts, and the frozen event union cannot represent the catalog's event types (DATA-REPOSITORY-CONTRACT.md 6 C1, C3, S1).

milestones.name: Create an investigation
milestones.basis: Owner-named INV-001, INV-002, INV-004, INV-023, EXT-DATA-008 (J1-03); none has a scope dependsOn. Text additions on the start screen: INV-019/020/021 (validation of the named fields), INV-022 (Cancel writes nothing), INV-005 (destination indicator), INV-006 (identifier the journey reads), INV-003 (applicable only when a domain profile is selected), INV-007/INV-018 (timestamp and state after Start). Genuine on T13 and T17. EXT-DATA-008's round-trip verification needs the M4 save path, an edge the DAG does not declare. Blocked: no creation path in SaveMachine.Initial/Encode, and no wire field for INV-023.

milestones.name: Edit and persist
milestones.basis: Owner-named INV-015, INV-016, INV-037, PERSIST-007, PERSIST-021, PERSIST-030, PERSIST-031. Added by dependsOn: UI-016, PERSIST-011, PERSIST-012, PERSIST-015, PERSIST-010. From the journeys: INV-017 (J1-06), PERSIST-032 (J3-04). Text additions: the save-state machine rules the named state meanings rely on (PERSIST-002/003/004/006/008/009/013/014/016/018/019/020/022/023/024/025/033, UI-006, INV-043) and the PAT requirements the named obligations cite (PERSIST-041, PERSIST-049, PERSIST-051). PERSIST-054 (PAT-15, T31) is excluded. Forward dependencies: INV-037 and INV-017 depend on M5 content (INV-012/014/024/026/027/028/030/031/033), so at M4 they hold only for the creation fields J1-05/J1-06 check. All T12/T14/T18 -> T19 -> T20 -> T21 edges are genuine persistence dependencies.

milestones.name: Analysis
milestones.basis: Analysis content and views: observations, hypotheses, evidence, links and kinds with rationale, reassessment (INV-030/031/035/038/044), editing (INV-034, a dependsOn of INV-035, and INV-036), conclusions (INV-032/033), and views UI-003 (timeline), UI-005/UI-033 (J2-05), UI-026 (causal analysis), with UI-026's direct dependsOn WDL-001..012, WDL-014, WDL-015. WDL-011's PF-001..020 dependencies are not pulled; they stay in M6. Full INV-037 persistence and reload is judged by J2-09. Blocked in part by the wire format: no fields for observation source or evidence label, no 'inconclusive'/'consistent-with' relationship kinds, and no reassess, withdraw or edit events in causa-data v1.0.0.
